salvage.name: fused coin-clutch
salvage.blurb: Currency of the last day, melted into one honest lump.

salvage.name: vitric lens
salvage.blurb: Shows things slightly closer than they are. Brokers pay for that.

salvage.name: unmelted ledger-clasp
salvage.blurb: The book burned; the clasp kept its grip on nothing.

salvage.name: glass rose
salvage.blurb: Grown, not made. The stem is still growing, very slowly.

salvage.name: tallow seal
salvage.blurb: Stamped wax of a deeper epoch. Collectors get quiet around it.

salvage.name: watchman's eye
salvage.blurb: Pried from a vitrified citizen. It has stopped watching. Probably.

salvage.name: annealed songbar
salvage.blurb: Struck, it holds its note for an hour. The note is a word.

salvage.name: pane of true glass
salvage.blurb: Shows what is actually there. Priced accordingly.

salvage.name: lattice relay bead
salvage.blurb: Still warm. Still ticking. Somewhere, something notices it moving.

salvage.name: the small mirror that is warm
salvage.blurb: The brokers keep a standing bounty and a standing rule: wrap it.
